source: FotMob match details and normalized Clubalpha fixtures
question: What condition and configuration is this club in now?

weighting_policy.note: Goals, xG, shots on target, and big chances have equal weight when present. No fitted superiority has yet been demonstrated.

opponent_adjustment.method: leave-one-match-out opponent attack and defence baseline

preseason.note: Preseason can describe current condition but cannot dominate competitive evidence.

reliability.formula: confidence = evidence / (evidence + prior); final_z = standardised_z * confidence

team_standardisation.method: sample z-score across the current PL/UCL target universe
team_standardisation.timing: after recency, source, coverage, and opponent adjustments; before reliability shrinkage

opponent_context.note: Competition normalisation and a shrunk leave-one-out opponent adjustment are applied before aggregation. Historical matchup effects remain in Historical Fixtures.

availability.note: FotMob injury flags are surfaced with Alpha Ability context. They do not change Club Form until a projected lineup and expected-minutes layer exists.
